G3956.def:
**πᾶς**, πᾶσα, πᾶν, genitive, παντός, πάσης, παντός,
[in LXX chiefly for כֹּל ;]
**all, every**.
I. As adj.,
1. with subst. anarth., **all, every, of every kind**: [[Mat.3.10; 4.23|Mat.3:10 4:23]], [[Mrk.9.49|Mrk.9:49]], [[Luk.4.37|Luk.4:37]], [[Jhn.2.1|Jhn.2:1]]o, [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[Rom.7.8|Rom.7:8]], [[Rev.18.17|Rev.18:17]], al. mult.; pl., **all**, [[Act.22.15|Act.22:15]], [[Rom.5.12|Rom.5:12]], [[Heb.1.6|Heb.1:6]], al.; of the highest degree, π. ἐξουσία (προθυμία, χαρά), [[Mat.28.18|Mat.28:18]], [[Act.17.11|Act.17:11]], [[Php.2.29|Phi 2:29]], al.; also **the whole** (though in this sense more frequently with art.), [[Mat.2.3|Mat.2:3]], [[Act.2.36|Act.2:36]], [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]].
2. C. art. (before the art., after the noun, or, denoting totality, between the art. and noun), **all, whole**: [[Mat.8.32; 13.2|Mat.8:32 13:2]], [[Mrk.5.33|Mrk.5:33]], [[Luk.1.10|Luk.1:10]], [[Act.7.14|Act.7:14]], [[Rom.3.19|Rom.3:19]], [[Gal.5.14|Gal.5:14]], [[Eph.4.16|Eph.4:16]], al.; pl., [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Mrk.4.13|Mrk.4:13]], [[Rom.1.5|Rom.1:5]], al.
II. As pron.,
1. masc. and fem., **every one**: [[Mrk.9.49|Mrk.9:49]], [[Luk.16.16|Luk.16:16]], [[Heb.2.9|Heb.2:9]]; before rel. pron., [[Mat.7.24|Mat.7:24]], [[Act.2.21|Act.2:21]], [[Gal.3.10|Gal.3:10]], al.; with ptcp. (anarth.), [[Mat.13.19|Mat.13:19]], [[Luk.11.4|Luk.11:4]]; with ptcp. (with art.), [[Mat.5.22|Mat.5:22]], [[Mrk.7.8|Mrk.7:8]], [[Luk.6.47|Luk.6:47]], [[Jhn.3.8|Jhn.3:8]], [[Rom.1.16|Rom.1:16]], al.; pl., πάντες, absol., **all, all men**, [[Mat.10.22|Mat.10:22]], [[Mrk.13.13|Mrk.13:13]], [[Luk.20.38|Luk.20:38]], [[Jhn.1.7; 3.26|Jhn.1:7 3:26]], [[1Co.8.1|1Co.8:1]], al.; οἱ π. (collectively, as a definite whole), [[Rom.11.32|Rom.11:32]], [[1Co.1.17|1Co.1:17]], [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]], al.; π. οἱ (ὅσοι), [[Mat.4.24|Mat.4:24]], [[Mrk.1.32|Mrk.1:32]], [[Luk.4.40|Luk.4:40]], al.
2. Neut.,
(a) sing., πᾶν, **everything, all**: πᾶν τό, with ptcp., [[1Co.10.25, 27|1Co.10:25, 27]], [[Eph.5.13|Eph.5:13]], [[1Jn.2.16; 5.4|1Jn.2:16 5:4]] (sc. ὄν); πᾶν ὅ, [[Jhn.17.2|Jhn.17:2]], [[Rom.14.23|Rom.14:23]]; collectively, of persons (Westc., in l.), [[Jhn.6.37, 39|Jhn.6:37, 39]]; with prep., in adverbial phrases, διὰ παντός, **always**, [[Mat.18.10|Mat.18:10]], al.; ἐν παντί, **in everything, in every way**, [[2Co.4.8|2Co.4:8]], [[Php.4.6|Phi 4:6]], al.;
(b) pl., πάτνα, **all things**: absol., [[Jhn.1.3|Jhn.1:3]], [[1Co.2.10|1Co.2:10]], [[Heb.2.8|Heb.2:8]], al.; of certain specified things, [[Mrk.4.34|Mrk.4:34]], [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]], [[Rom.8.28|Rom.8:28]], [[1Th.5.21|1Th.5:21]], al.; accusative, πάντα, adverbially, **wholly, in all things, in all respects**, [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]], [[1Co.9.25|1Co.9:25]], al.; with art., τὰ π., **all things** (a totality, as distinct from anarth. πάντα, all things severally; cf. Westc, _Eph._, 186f.), absol.: [[Rom.11.36|Rom.11:36]], [[1Co.8.6|1Co.8:6]], [[Eph.3.9|Eph.3:9]], [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]], al.; relatively, [[Mrk.4.11|Mrk.4:11]], [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]], [[Rom.8.32|Rom.8:32]], al.; πάντα, with ptcp., [[Mat.18.31|Mat.18:31]], al.; πάντα ταῦτα (ταῦτα π.), [[Mat.6.32, 33|Mat.6:32, 33]], al.; πάντα, with prep, in adverbial phrases, πρὸ πάντων, **above all things**, [[Jas.5.12|Jas.5:12]], [[1Pe.4.8|1Pe.4:8]]; ἐν π́, **in all things, in all ways**, [[1Ti.3.11|1Ti.3:11]], [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]], al.; κατὰ πάντα, **in all respects**, [[Act.17.22|Act.17:22]], al.
3. C. neg., πᾶς οὐ (μή) = οὐδείς, see: οὐ and μή, and cf. M, _Pr._, 245f.
(AS)

G3996.def:
**πενθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for אָבַל ;]
to mourn (for), lament;
(a) intrans. : [[Mat.5.4|Mat.5:4]] (5) [[Mat.9.15|Mat.9:15]], [[1Co.5.2|1Co.5:2]]; π. καὶ κλαίειν, [[Mat.16.10|Mat.16:10]], [[Luk.6.25|Luk.6:25]], [[Jas.4.9|Jas.4:9]], [[Rev.18.15, 19|Rev.18:15, 19]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Rev.18.11|Rev.18:11]]
(b) trans., with accusative, [[2Co.12.21|2Co.12:21]]†
_SYN._: see: θρηνέω (AS)

G3928.def:
**παρ-ἐρχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;]
1. **to pass, pass by**;
(a) **of persons**: absol., [[Luk.18.37|Luk.18:37]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]] with accusative lot., [[Act.16.8|Act.16:8]] before διά, with genitive, [[Mat.8.28|Mat.8:28]]
(b) **of things **: τ. ποτήριον, [[Mat.26.39|Mat.26:39]] (ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ), [[Mat.26.42|Mat.26:42]] of time, [[Mat.14.15|Mat.14:15]], [[Mrk.14.35|Mrk.14:35]], [[Act.27.9|Act.27:9]], [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]]. Metaphorical,
(a) **to pass away, perish**: [[Mat.5.18; 24.34-35|Mat.5:18 24:34-35]] [[Mrk.13.30-31|Mrk.13:30-31]], [[Luk.16.17; 21.32-33|Luk.16:17 21:32-33]], [[2Co.5.17|2Co.5:17]], [[Jas.1.10|Jas.1:10]], [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]];
(b) **to pass by, neglect, disregard**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.11.42; 15.29|Luk.11:42 15:29]].
2. **to come to, arrive**: [[Luk.12.37; 17.7|Luk.12:37 17:7]], [[Act.24.7|Act.24:7]], R, mg. (cf. ἀντι-παρέρχομαι).†
_SYN._: παραβαίνω (AS)

G3924.def:
**παρ-εκτός ** = cl. παρέκ, -έξ,
[in Aq.: [[Deu.1.36|Deu.1:36]] Al., [[Lev.23.38|Lev.23:38]] * ;]
1. as adv., **besides, in addition**: τὰ π. (sc. γινόμενα), [[2Co.11.28|2Co.11:28]]
2. As prep. with genitive, **except**: [[Mat.5.32; 19.9|Mat.5:32 19:9]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[Act.26.29|Act.26:29]]†
(AS)

G3986.def:
**πειρασμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(πειράζω), [in LXX for מַסָּה, עִנְיָן ;]
1. = πεῖρα, an experiment Diosc.).
2. a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (see Hort on [[Jas.1.13|Jas.1:13]])
(a) **in good or neutral sense**: [[Gal.4.14|Gal.4:14]], [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]], [[1Pe.4.12|1Pe.4:12]]; esp. of afflictions sent by God ([[Deu.7.19|Deu.7:19]], [[Sir.21.1-28|Sir.21:1-28]], al.): [[2Pe.2.9|2Pe.2:9]], [[Rev.3.10|Rev.3:10]]; pl., [[Luk.22.28|Luk.22:28]], [[Act.20.19|Act.20:19]], [[Jas.1.2|Jas.1:2]], [[1Pe.1.6|1Pe.1:6]];
(b) **of trial regarded as leading to sin, temptation**: [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]], [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]], [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]]; of the temptation of Jesus by the devil, [[Luk.4.13|Luk.4:13]] εἰσφέρειν (ἔρχεσθαι, εἰσέρχ-) εἰς π., [[Mat.6.13; 26.41|Mat.6:13 26:41]], [[Mrk.14.38|Mrk.14:38]], [[Luk.11.4; 22.40, 46|Luk.11:4 22:40, 46]];
(with) of the testing or challenge of God by man (see: πειράζω, 3, with) : [[Heb.3.8|Heb.3:8]] (LXX: [[Psa.95.9|Psa.95:9]], where κατα τ. ἡμέραν πειρασμοῦ = מַסָּה the day of Massah).†
_SYN._: δοκίμιον (AS)

G3900.def:
**παρά-πτωρμα**, -τος, τό
(παραπίπτω), [in LXX for מַעַל, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;]
1. a false step, a blunder (Polyb.).
2. Ethically, a misdeed, trespass (LXX): [[Mat.6.14-15|Mat.6:14-15]], [[Mrk.11.25-26|Mrk.11:25-26]], [[Rom.4.25; 5.15|Rom.4:25 5:15]] ff [[Rom.11.11-12|Rom.11:11-12]], [[2Co.5.19|2Co.5:19]], [[Gal.6.1|Gal.6:1]], [[Eph.1.7; 2.1, 5|Eph.1:7 2:1, 5]], [[Col.2.13|Col.2:13]].†
_SYN._: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

G3994.def:
**πενθερά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of πενθερός), [in LXX for חֲמוֹת ;]
**a mother-in-law**: [[Mat.8.14; 10.35|Mat.8:14 10:35]], [[Mrk.1.30|Mrk.1:30]], [[Luk.4.38; 12.53|Luk.4:38 12:53]].†
(AS)

G3975.def:
**παχύνω**
(παχύς, thick) [in LXX: [[Deu.32.15|Deu.32:15]], [[Isa.6.10|Isa.6:10]] (שָׁמֵן), al. ;]
**to thicken, fatten**; pass., to grow fat. Metaphorical, to make dull or stupid (τ. ψυχάς, Rut.); pass., **to wax gross**: ἡ καρδία„ [[Mat.13.15|Mat.13:15]], [[Act.28.27|Act.28:27]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3908.def:
**παρα-τίθημι **
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם ;]
I. Act., to place beside, set before, with accusative and dative: of food, [[Mrk.6.41; 8.6-7|Mrk.6:41 8:6-7]], [[Luk.9.16; 11.6|Luk.9:16 11:6]]; τράπεζαν, [[Act.16.34|Act.16:34]] pass. ptcp., [[Luk.10.8|Luk.10:8]], [[1Co.10.27|1Co.10:27]]; metaphorically, of teaching, παραβολήν, [[Mat.13.24, 31|Mat.13:24, 31]].
II. Mid.,
1. to have set before one (Hom., Thuc., Xen., al.).
2. to deposit with another, give in charge or commit to (Hdt., Xen., Polyb., al.) : with accusative and dative, [[Luk.12.48; 23.46|Luk.12:48 23:46]], [[Act.14.23; 20.32|Act.14:23 20:32]], [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]], [[2Ti.2.2|2Ti.2:2]], [[1Pe.4.19|1Pe.4:19]].
3. **to bring forward, quote as evidence**: before ὅτι, [[Act.17.3|Act.17:3]] (see Page, in l).†
(AS)

G3968.def:
**πατρίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹלֶדֶת ;]
prop. poët. fern. of πάτριος, of one's fathers; as subst., ἡ π. = πάτρα, fatherland, **country, home, native place**: [[Act.18.27|Act.18:27]], WH, mg., [[Heb.11.14|Heb.11:14]] of one's own town, [[Mat.13.54, 57|Mat.13:54, 57]], [[Mrk.6.1|Mrk.6:1]], 4, [[Luk.4.23-24|Luk.4:23-24]], [[Jhn.4.44|Jhn.4:44]].†
(AS)

G3979.def:
**πεζός**, -ή, -όν
(πούς), [in LXX for רַגְלִי ;]
1. **on foot**: [[Mat.14.13|Mat.14:13]] (WH, mg., R, txt.).
2. Opp. to going by sea, **by land**: [[Mat.14.13|Mat.14:13]] (WH, mg., R, mg.).
3. As adv., πεζῇ (sc. ὁδῷ), **on foot or by land**: Mt 1413 (WH, txt.), [[Mrk.6.33|Mrk.6:33]]†
(AS)

G3989.def:
**πέλαγος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX: [[2Ma.5.21|2Ma.5:21]], [[4Ma.7.1|4Ma.7:1]] * ;]
**the deep sea, the deep, the sea**: [[Act.27.5|Act.27:5]] τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]]
_SYN._: θαλάσσα (which see); and cf. ἄβυσσος (AS)

G3953.def:
**παρ-οψίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(παρά, ὄψον; see: ὀψάριον),
1. a side-dish of dainties (Xen., al.).
2. **In Comic poets and late prose, the dish itself on which the dainties are served**: [[Mat.23.25-26|Mat.23:25-26]] (In this sense it is condemned by the Atticists; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 265 f.)†
(AS)

G3930.def:
**παρ-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.30.7|Psa.30:7]] (עָמַד hi.), etc. ;]
I. Active voice.,
1. **to furnish, provide, supply**; with ref. to incorporeal things, **to afford, show, give, cause**: with accusative, [[Act.22.2|Act.22:2]], [[1Ti.1.4|1Ti.1:4]]; with accusative and dative, [[Mat.26.10|Mat.26:10]], [[Mrk.14.6|Mrk.14:6]], [[Luk.11.7; 18.5|Luk.11:7 18:5]], [[Act.16.16; 17.31; 28.2|Act.16:16 17:31 28:2]], [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]], [[1Ti.6.17|1Ti.6:17]].
2. **to present, offer**: with accusative and dative, [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]] with prop. reflex. and accusative pred., to show or present oneself (see infr., and cf. B1., § 55, 1).
II. Middle voice.,
1. **to supply, furnish or display of one's own part**: with accusative and dative, [[Luk.7.4|Luk.7:4]], [[Act.19.24|Act.19:24]], [[Col.4.1|Col.4:1]].
2. In late writers, with prop. reflex. and accusative pred. (= act. ut supr.), to show or present oneself (Xen., FlJ, al.; cf. M, _Pr._, 248; Deiss., BS, 254) : [[Tit.2.7|Tit.2:7]]†
(AS)

G3960.def:
**πατάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for נָכָה hi., also for נָגַף, etc. ;]
1. in Hom., intrans., to beat (of the heart).
2. Trans. = πλήσσω, **to strike, smite**: absol., ἐν μαχαίρᾳ, [[Luk.22.49|Luk.22:49]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.26.51|Mat.26:51]], [[Luk.22.50|Luk.22:50]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.12.7|Act.12:7]] of a deadly blow, [[Mat.26.31|Mat.26:31]], [[Mrk.14.27|Mrk.14:27]], [[Act.7.24|Act.7:24]]. Metaphorical, of disease: [[Act.12.23|Act.12:23]], [[Rev.11.6; 19.15|Rev.11:6 19:15]].†
(AS)

G3918.def:
**πάρ-ειμι **
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;]
1. **to be by, at hand or present**;
(a) **of persons**: [[Rev.17.8|Rev.17:8]] παρών (opposite to ἀπών), [[1Co.5.3|1Co.5:3]], [[2Co.10.2; 10.11; 13.2; 13.10|2Co.10:2 10:11 13:2 13:10]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[Act.24.19|Act.24:19]] ἐνώπιον, [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]] ἐνθάδε, [[Act.17.6|Act.17:6]] πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.12.20|Act.12:20]], [[2Co.11.8|2Co.11:8]], [[Gal.4.18, 20|Gal.4:18, 20]];
(b) **of things **: of time, ὁ καιρός, [[Jhn.7.6|Jhn.7:6]] τ. παρόν, [[Heb.12.11|Heb.12:11]] ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[2Pe.1.12|2Pe.1:12]] ταῦτα, [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]] τ. παρόντα, [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]]
2. to have come or arrived (Hdt., Thuc., al.; see Field, _Notes_, 65) : [[Luk.13.1|Luk.13:1]], [[Jhn.11.28|Jhn.11:28]], [[Act.10.21|Act.10:21]]; before εἰς, [[Col.1.6|Col.1:6]] before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.26.50|Mat.26:50]] (cf. συν-πάρειμι).†
(AS)

G3936.def:
**παρ-ίστημι **
[in LXX for עָמַד, etc. ;]
I. Transitive verb. in present tense., imperfect., future tense., 1 aorist.;
1. **to place beside, present, provide**: with accusative, [[Act.9.41; 23.24|Act.9:41 23:24]], [[2Co.4.14|2Co.4:14]], [[Col.1.28|Col.1:28]]; with accusative and dative, [[Mat.26.53|Mat.26:53]], [[Luk.2.22|Luk.2:22]], [[Act.1.3; 23.33|Act.1:3 23:33]], [[1Co.8.8|1Co.8:8]]; before accusative pred., [[Rom.6.13, 16|Rom.6:13, 16]] (late pres., παριστάνετε), [[Rom.6.19; 12.1|Rom.6:19 12:1]], [[2Co.11.2|2Co.11:2]], [[Eph.5.27|Eph.5:27]], [[Col.1.22|Col.1:22]], [[2Ti.2.15|2Ti.2:15]].
2. to present to the mind (cl.) : by argument, to prove (Xen., FlJ, al.), with accusative, [[Act.24.13|Act.24:13]]
II. Intransitive. in perfect., pluperfect., 2 aorist.;
1. **to stand by or beside one **: with dative of person(s), [[Act.1.10; 9.39; 23.2; 27.23|Act.1:10 9:39 23:2 27:23]]; ptcp., [[Mrk.14.47, 69-70; 15.35, 39|Mrk.14:47, 69-70 15:35, 39]] [[Jhn.18.22; 19.26|Jhn.18:22 19:26]].
2. **to appear**: with nom. pred., before ἐνώπιον, [[Act.4.10|Act.4:10]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.27.24|Act.27:24]] so fut. mid. (of. LS, see word, B, ii, 2), [[Rom.14.10|Rom.14:10]]
3. **to be at hand, be present, have come**: [[Act.4.26|Act.4:26]] (LXX); of servants in attendance, ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[Luk.1.19|Luk.1:19]] absol., οἱ παρεστῶτες, [[Luk.19.24|Luk.19:24]] before αὐτῷ, [[Act.23.2|Act.23:2]], 4; of time, [[Mrk.4.29|Mrk.4:29]]
4. **to stand by for help or defence **(Hom., Dem., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[Rom.16.2|Rom.16:2]], [[2Ti.4.17|2Ti.4:17]].†
(AS)

G3982.def:
**πείθω**,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;]
(i) **Active; **
1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, _Pr._, 147), **to prevail upon or win over, persuade**: absol., [[Mat.28.14|Mat.28:14]], [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]] before περί, with genitive of thing(s), [[Act.19.8|Act.19:8]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.12.20; 14.19; 18.4|Act.12:20 14:19 18:4]], [[2Co.5.11|2Co.5:11]], [[Gal.1.10|Gal.1:10]]; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, [[1Jn.3.19|1Jn.3:19]] with accusative before περί, [[Act.28.23|Act.28:23]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.13.43; 26.28|Act.13:43 26:28]] (see Field, _Notes_, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), [[Mat.27.20|Mat.27:20]]
2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, _Pr._, 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, **be confident, have confidence**: with accusative and inf., [[Rom.2.19|Rom.2:19]] with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l) : [[Php.1.6, 25|Php.1:6, 25]]; with dative, [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]], Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., [[2Co.10.7|2Co.10:7]] before ἐν, [[Php.3.3-4;|Php.3:3-4]] ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, [[Php.2.24|Php.2:24]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] (WH, mg.), [[Mrk.10.24|Mrk.10:24]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[Luk.11.22; 18.9|Luk.11:22 18:9]], [[2Co.1.9|2Co.1:9]], [[Heb.2.13|Heb.2:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, [[2Co.2.3|2Co.2:3]], [[2Th.3.4|2Th.3:4]] (see Lft., _Notes_, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, [[Gal.5.10|Gal.5:10]]
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
1. to be persuaded, believe (see M, _Pr._, 158) : absol., [[Luk.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[Act.17.4; 21.14|Act.17:4 21:14]], [[Heb.13.18|Heb.13:18]]; with dative, [[Act.28.24|Act.28:24]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.26.26|Act.26:26]] so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, [[Heb.6.9|Heb.6:9]] with accusative and inf., [[Luk.20.6|Luk.20:6]] ὅτι, [[Rom.8.38|Rom.8:38]], [[2Ti.1.5; 1.12|2Ti.1:5 1:12]]; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, [[Rom.14.14|Rom.14:14]] περί, with genitive before ὅτι, [[Rom.15.14|Rom.15:14]]
2. **to listen to, obey**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.5.36-37, 40; 23.21; 27.11|Act.5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11]], [[Rom.2.8|Rom.2:8]], [[Gal.5.7|Gal.5:7]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[Jas.3.3|Jas.3:3]] (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†
**Πειθώ**, -οῦς, ἡ
1. Peitho, Persuasion (as a goddess).
2. **per­suasion**: ἐν πειθοῖ (so Orig., Eus. and some cursives in [[1Co.2.4|1Co.2:4]] for πειθός, which see).†
(AS)

G3904.def:
**παρα-σκευή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Exo.35.24; 39.42|Exo.35:24 39:42]] (עֲבֹדָה, with seel., ἀποσκ-, κατασκ-), [[Jdt.2.17; 4.5|Jdth.2:17 4:5]], [[1Ma.9.35|1Ma.9:35]] א, [[2Ma.15.21|2Ma.15:21]] * ;]
1. preparation.
2. equipment (Jth, ll with).
3. In Jewish usage, the day of preparation for a Sabbath or a feast (= προσάββατον, which see) : [[Mat.27.62|Mat.27:62]], [[Mrk.15.42|Mrk.15:42]], [[Luk.23.54|Luk.23:54]], [[Jhn.19.31|Jhn.19:31]]; with genitive, τοῦ πάσχα, [[Jhn.19.14|Jhn.19:14]] τ. Ἰoυδαίων, [[Jhn.19.42|Jhn.19:42]] (it is the name for Friday in M_Gr._).†
(AS)

G3906.def:
**παρα-τηρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Psa.37.12|Psa.37:12]] (זָמַם), [[Psa.130.8|Psa.130:8]] (שָׁמַר), Da TH [[Dan.6.11|Dan.6:11]] (12), [[Sus.1.12,15|Su 1:12,15]],16* ;]
1. **to watch closely, observe narrowly**: so mid., τ. πύλας, [[Act.9.24|Act.9:24]] with evil intent, [[Mrk.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[Luk.20.20|Luk.20:20]] (absol., see Field, _Notes_, 74); so mid., [[Luk.6.7; 14.1|Luk.6:7 14:1]].
2. to observe scrupulously (of days and seasons; cf. [[Exo.12.42|Exo.12:42]], Sm.): mid., [[Gal.4.10|Gal.4:10]]†
(AS)

G3976.def:
**πέδη**, -ης, ἡ
(πέζα, the instep), [in LXX for נְחֹשֶׁת, etc. ;]
**a fetter**: [[Mrk.5.4|Mrk.5:4]], [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]].†
(AS)

G3954.def:
**παρρησία**, -ας, ἡ
(πᾶς + ῥῆσις, speech) [in LXX; [[Lev.26.13|Lev.26:13]] (μετὰ π., קוֺמְמִיּוּת קוֹמְמִיּוּת), [[Pro.1.20; 10.10|Pro.1:20 10:10]], [[Wis.5.1|Wis.5:1]], al. ;]
1. freedom of speech, plainness, openness, freedom in speaking (Eur., Plat., al.) : [[Act.4.13|Act.4:13]], [[2Co.3.12|2Co.3:12]]; παρρησίᾳ, adverbially, freely, openly, plainly, [[Mrk.8.32|Mrk.8:32]], [[Jhn.7.13, 26; 10.24; 11.14; 16.29; 18.20|Jhn.7:13, 26 10:24 11:14 16:29 18:20]]; opposite to ἐν παροιμίαις, [[Jhn.16.25|Jhn.16:25]] ἐν π., [[Eph.6.19|Eph.6:19]] μετὰ π., [[Act.2.29; 4.29, 31; 28.31|Act.2:29 4:29, 31 28:31]]
2. In LXX ([[1Ma.4.18|1Ma.4:18]], [[Wis.5.1|Wis.5:1]], al.), FlJ, and NT, also (from the absence of fear which accompanies freedom of speech), **confidence, boldness**: [[2Co.7.4|2Co.7:4]], [[Php.1.20|Php.1:20]], [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]]; ἔχειν π., [[Eph.3.12|Eph.3:12]], Phm 8, [[Heb.3.6; 10.19, 35|Heb.3:6 10:19, 35]], [[1Jn.2.28|1Jn.2:28]] [[Jhn.3.21|Jn 3:21]] [[Jhn.4.17|Jn 4:17]] [[Jhn.5.14|Jn 5:14]]; μετὰ π., He 416; ἐν π., [[Col.2.15|Col.2:15]] id. (as בפרהסיא in Rabbinic lit.; see Westc., Jo., i, 262), in public, [[Jhn.7.4|Jhn.7:4]] and (without ἐν) [[Jhn.11.54|Jhn.11:54]]†
(AS)

G3911.def:
**παρα-φέρω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.21.13|1Ki.21:13]] (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), and as seel. 2* ;]
1. to bring to, set before, esp. of food (Hdt., al.).
2. **to take or carry away**: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[Mrk.14.36|Mrk.14:36]], [[Luk.22.42|Luk.22:42]]; pass., before ὑπό, [[Jude.12|Ju 12]]; metaphorically, pass., with dative, [[Heb.13.9|Heb.13:9]]†
(AS)

G3965.def:
**πατριά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for אָב, [[Exo.6.14|Exo.6:14]], al., also for מִשְׁפָּחָה, [[Exo.6.15|Exo.6:15]], [[2Ki.14.7|4Ki.14:7]], [[Psa.22.27|Psa.22:27]], al. ;]
1. lineage, ancestry (Hdt.).
2. = πάτρα (more common in cl.), a family or tribe (so sometimes in Hdt., in LXX of related people, in a sense narrower than φυλή and wider than οἶκος; see [[Exo.12.3|Exo.12:3]], [[Num.32.28|Num.32:28]]): [[Luk.2.4|Luk.2:4]]; in a wider sense ([[1Ch.16.28|1Ch.16:28]], [[Psa.22.27|Psa.22:27]]), [[Act.3.25|Act.3:25]]" (LXX) [[Eph.3.15|Eph.3:15]]†
(AS)

G3973.def:
**παύω **
[in LXX for כָּלָה pi., etc. ;]
**to make to cease, restrain, hinder**: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό [[1Pe.3.10|1Pe.3:10]] (LXX). Mid., **to cease, leave off**: [[Luk.8.24; 11.1|Luk.8:24 11:1]], [[Act.20.1|Act.20:1]], [[1Co.13.8|1Co.13:8]]; with ptcp., [[Luk.5.4|Luk.5:4]], [[Act.5.42; 6.13; 13.10; 20.31; 21.32|Act.5:42 6:13 13:10 20:31 21:32]], [[Eph.1.16|Eph.1:16]], [[Col.1.9|Col.1:9]], [[Heb.10.2|Heb.10:2]]; with genitive, ἀμαρτίας, [[1Pe.4.1|1Pe.4:1]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with dative, ib. (WH, txt., R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3977.def:
**πεδινός**, -ή, -όν
(πεδίον, a plain), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.) ;]
**level, plain**: [[Luk.6.17|Luk.6:17]]†
(AS)

G3961.def:
**πατέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, etc. ;]
1. intrans., **to tread, walk**: before ἐπάνω ὄφεων κ.τ.λ. (figuratively), [[Luk.10.19|Luk.10:19]] (cf. [[Psa.91.13|Psa.91:13]]).
2. Trans., **to tread on, trample**: τ. ληνόν, [[Rev.14.20; 19.15|Rev.14:20 19:15]] (cf. [[Jdg.9.27|Jdg.9:27]], [[Lam.1.15|La 1:15]], al.); of the desecration of Jerusalem by its enemies, [[Luk.21.24|Luk.21:24]], [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, ἐν-περι-πατέω).†
(AS)

G3998.def:
**πενιχρός**, -ά, -όν
(πένομαι, see: πένης) [in LXX: [[Exo.22.25|Exo.22:25]] (עָנִי), [[Pro.28.15; 29.7|Pro.28:15 29:7]] (דַּל) * ;]
chiefly in Comic poets and late prose (but Plato, Rep., 578 A), = πένης,
**needy, poor**: [[Luk.21.2|Luk.21:2]] (for ex. in π., see MM, xix).†
(AS)

G3939.def:
**παρ-οικέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for גּוּר, also for יָשַׁב, שָׁכַן ]
in cl., to dwell beside (with accusative), among (with dative) or near by (absol.). In late writers, to dwell in a place as a πάροικος (which see) or stranger: [[Luk.24.18|Luk.24:18]], [[Heb.11.9|Heb.11:9]].†
(AS)

G3942.def:
**παροιμία**, -ας, ἡ
(πάροιμος, by the way), [in LXX. Pr title [[Pro.1.1; 25.1|Pro.1:1 25:1]], (מָשַׁל) subscr., [[Sir.6.35; 8.8; 18.29; 39.3; 47.17|Sir.6:35 8:8 18:29 39:3 47:17]] * ;]
1. a wayside saying (Hesych.; see LS, see word), **a byword, maxim, proverb**: [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]]
2. In NT, of figurative discourse (as מָשַׁל, [[Isa.14.4|Isa.14:4]], al.), **a parable, allegory**: [[Jhn.10.6; 16.25, 29|Jhn.10:6 16:25, 29]] (see Abbott, _Essays_, 82 ff.).†
_SYN._: παραβολή, q.v (AS)

G3995.def:
**πενθερός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חָם, [[Gen.38.13|Gen.38:13]], al.; also for חָתַן, [[Jdg.1.16|Jdg.1:16]] A ;]
**a father-in-law**: [[Jhn.18.13|Jhn.18:13]]†
(AS)

G3980.def:
**πειθαρχέω**, -ῶ
(πείθομαι, ἀρχή) [in LXX: Dan LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), [[Sir.33.28|Sir.33:28]], I [[Est.8.94|Est.8:94]] * ;]
**to obey one in authority, be obedient**: [[Tit.3.1|Tit.3:1]] with dative, [[Act.27.21|Act.27:21]] θεῷ, [[Act.5.29, 32|Act.5:29, 32]].†
(AS)

G3941.def:
**άρ-οικος**, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for גֵּר, תּוֹשָׁב ;]
1. in cl. Attic, dwelling near, neighbouring; as subst., a neighbour.
2. In late writers (LXX, Philo) and in Iuser. (Deiss., BS, 227 f.; Kennedy, _Sources_, 102), foreign, alien; as subst., **an alien, a sojourner**: [[Act.7.6|Act.7:6]] (LXX), [[Act.7.29|Act.7:29]] metapb., ξένοι καὶ π. (opposite to συμπολίτης), [[Eph.2.19|Eph.2:19]] π. καὶ παρεπιδήμους (which see), [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]] (see Lft. on Clem. Rom., 1 Co., § 1).†
(AS)

G3903.def:
**παρα-σκευάζω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.50.42|Jer.50:42]] (עָרַךְ), etc. ;]
**to prepare, make ready**: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, [[2Ma.2.27|2Ma.2:27]]), [[Act.10.10|Act.10:10]]; mid., **to prepare, make preparations**: [[1Co.14.8|1Co.14:8]] (cf. Je, l.with); pass., [[2Co.9.2-3|2Co.9:2-3]]†
(AS)

G3972.def:
**Παῦλος**, -ου, ὁ (Lat. Paulus),
1. **Sergius Paulus**: [[Act.13.7|Act.13:7]]
2. **the Apostle Paul** (cf. Σαῦλος): [[Act.13.9|Act.13:9]], and frequently throughout Ac., [[Rom.1.1|Rom.1:1]], [[1Co.1.1|1Co.1:1]], al., [[2Pe.3.15|2Pe.3:15]].
(AS)

G3951.def:
**παρ-οτρύνω **
**to urge on, stir up**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.13.50|Act.13:50]] (find., Hipp., and late writers).†
(AS)

G3944.def:
**παρ-οίχομαι **
**to have passed by; of time, to be gone by**: ἐν τ. παρῳχημέναις γενεαῖς, [[Act.14.16|Act.14:16]]†
(AS)

G3926.def:
**παρ-εν-οχλέω**, -ῶ
(cf. ἐνοχλέω), [in LXX for לָאָה hi. ([[Mic.6.3|Mic.6:3]]), etc. ;]
**to annoy concerning a matter **(παρά): with dative of person(s), [[Act.15.19|Act.15:19]]†
(AS)

G3947.def:
**παρ-οξύνω **
[in LXX for נָאַץ, קָצַף, רָגַז, etc. ;]
1. primarily, but never so in cl., to sharpen (μάχαιραν, [[Deu.32.41|Deu.32:41]], שָׁנַן).
2. Metaphorical, as always in cl.,
(a) **to spur on, stimulate **(Arist., Xen., al.);
(b) to provoke, rouse to anger ([[Deu.9.7, 18|Deu.9:7, 18]], [[Psa.106.29|Psa.106:29]], al.) : pass., [[Act.17.16|Act.17:16]], [[1Co.13.5|1Co.13:5]].†
(AS)

G3909.def:
**παρα-τυγχάνω **
**to happen to be near or present**: [[Act.17.17|Act.17:17]]†
(AS)

G3905.def:
**παρα-τείνω **
[in LXX: [[Num.23.28|Num.23:28]] (שָׁקַף ni.), etc. ;]
**to extend, pro­long**: τ. λόγον, [[Act.20.7|Act.20:7]]†
(AS)

G3978.def:
**πεζεύω**
(πεζός)
**to travel on foot or by land**: [[Act.20.13|Act.20:13]]†
(AS)

G3959.def:
**Πάταρα**, -ων, τὰ
**Patara, a maritime city of Lycia**: [[Act.21.1|Act.21:1]]†
(AS)

G3987.def:
**πειράω ** more commonly as depon., πειράομαι,
[in LXX for נָסָה ;]
**to try, attempt**: [[Act.26.21|Act.26:21]]†
(AS)

G3914.def:
**παρα-χειμάζω **
**to winter at a place**: before εἰς, [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]] ἐν, [[Act.28.11|Act.28:11]] πρὸς ὑμᾶς, [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]] ἐκεῖ, [[Tit.3.12|Tit.3:12]]†
(AS)

G3902.def:
**παράσημος**, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark) [in LXX: [[3Ma.2.29|3Ma.2:29]] * ;]
1. in cl., marked amiss, spurious, counterfeit. Later,
2. marked at the side, annotated (Plut.).
3. marked with a sign (LXX); as subst., **a figure­head **: [[Act.28.11|Act.28:11]] (see MM, xix).†
(AS)

G3929.def:
**πάρεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(παρίημι),
1. a letting go, dismissal.
2. prætermission, passing by (of debt or sin) : [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]]†
_SYN._: ἄφεσις, q.v (AS)

G3922.def:
**παρ-εισ-έρχομαι **
1. **to come in beside or by the way**: [[Rom.5.20|Rom.5:20]]
2. **to come in secretly, steal in**: [[Gal.2.4|Gal.2:4]]†
(AS)

G3949.def:
**παρ-οργίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for כַּעַס hi. ;]
(in cl., passive only), **to provoke to anger**: [[Rom.10.19|Rom.10:19]] (LXX), [[Eph.6.4|Eph.6:4]]†
(AS)

G3938.def:
**πάρ-οδος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Gen.38.14|Gen.38:14]] (דֶּרֶךְ), etc. ;]
**a passing or passage**: ἐν π., in passing, [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]]†
(AS)

G3910.def:
**παρ-αυτίκα**
_ adv._ (πάραυτα = παρ ̓ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα) [in LXX: [[Psa.70.3|Psa.70:3]], [[Tob.4.14|Tob.4:14]] * ;]
1. immediately.
2. C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), **momentary, for a moment**: [[2Co.4.17|2Co.4:17]]†
(AS)

G3993.def:
**πένης**, -ητος, ὁ
(πένομαι, to work for one's daily bread), [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, עָנִי, דַּל, etc. ;]
**one who works for his living, a labourer, a poor man**: [[2Co.9.9|2Co.9:9]]†
_SYN._: πτωχός, properly a beggar and implying deeper poverty than π. (see Tr., _Syn._, § xxxvi, Abbott, _Essays_, 78) (AS)

G3912.def:
**παρα-φρονέω**
(ιαρά, φρήν), [in LXX: [[Zec.7.11|Zec.7:11]] (סָרַר)* ;]
**to be beside oneself, be deranged**: [[2Co.11.23|2Co.11:23]]†
(AS)

G3920.def:
**παρ-είσ-ακτος**, -ον
(παρεισάγω),
brought in secretly (as spies or traitors) : [[Gal.2.4|Gal.2:4]]†
(AS)

G3988.def:
**πεισμονή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(πείθω),
**persuasion**: [[Gal.5.8|Gal.5:8]]†
**πείθω**,
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח בֶּטַח, its parts and derivatives ;]
(i) **Active; **
1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, _Pr._, 147), **to prevail upon or win over, persuade**: absol., [[Mat.28.14|Mat.28:14]], [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]] before περί, with genitive of thing(s), [[Act.19.8|Act.19:8]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.12.20; 14.19; 18.4|Act.12:20 14:19 18:4]], [[2Co.5.11|2Co.5:11]], [[Gal.1.10|Gal.1:10]]; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, [[1Jn.3.19|1Jn.3:19]] with accusative before περί, [[Act.28.23|Act.28:23]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.13.43; 26.28|Act.13:43 26:28]] (see Field, _Notes_, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), [[Mat.27.20|Mat.27:20]]
2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, _Pr._, 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, **be confident, have confidence**: with accusative and inf., [[Rom.2.19|Rom.2:19]] with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l) : [[Php.1.6, 25|Php.1:6, 25]]; with dative, [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]], Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., [[2Co.10.7|2Co.10:7]] before ἐν, [[Php.3.3-4;|Php.3:3-4]] ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, [[Php.2.24|Php.2:24]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] (WH, mg.), [[Mrk.10.24|Mrk.10:24]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[Luk.11.22; 18.9|Luk.11:22 18:9]], [[2Co.1.9|2Co.1:9]], [[Heb.2.13|Heb.2:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, [[2Co.2.3|2Co.2:3]], [[2Th.3.4|2Th.3:4]] (see Lft., _Notes_, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, [[Gal.5.10|Gal.5:10]]
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
1. to be persuaded, believe (see M, _Pr._, 158) : absol., [[Luk.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[Act.17.4; 21.14|Act.17:4 21:14]], [[Heb.13.18|Heb.13:18]]; with dative, [[Act.28.24|Act.28:24]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.26.26|Act.26:26]] so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, [[Heb.6.9|Heb.6:9]] with accusative and inf., [[Luk.20.6|Luk.20:6]] ὅτι, [[Rom.8.38|Rom.8:38]], [[2Ti.1.5; 1.12|2Ti.1:5 1:12]]; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, [[Rom.14.14|Rom.14:14]] περί, with genitive before ὅτι, [[Rom.15.14|Rom.15:14]]
2. **to listen to, obey**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.5.36-37, 40; 23.21; 27.11|Act.5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11]], [[Rom.2.8|Rom.2:8]], [[Gal.5.7|Gal.5:7]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[Jas.3.3|Jas.3:3]] (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†
(AS)

G3950.def:
**παρ-οργισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(παροργίζω), [in LXX: [[3Ki.15.30|3Ki.15:30]], [[2Ki.23.26|4Ki.23:26]] (כַּעַס); [[4Ki.19.3|4Ki.19:3]], [[Neh.9.18, 26|Neh.9:18, 26]] (נְאָצָה); [[Jer.21.5|Jer.21:5]] A (קֶצֶף) * ;]
irritation ("distinguished from ὀργή as implying a less permanent state"; _ICC_, _Eph._, 140; and see Tr., _Syn._, § xxxvii) : [[Eph.4.26|Eph.4:26]]†
(AS)

G3931.def:
**παρηγορία**, -ας, ἡ
(παρηγορέω, to address, exhort, console) [in LXX: [[4Ma.5.12|4Ma.5:12]] [[4Mac.6.1|4Mac 6:1]] * ;]
1. an address, exhortation (LXX, ll. with).
2. **comfort, consolation**: [[Col.4.11|Col.4:11]]†
(AS)

G3964.def:
**πατρολῴας** (-αλῴας, Rec.; in cl. -αλοίας, see Bl., § 3, 3; 6, 2, and cf. μητρολῴας), -ου, ὁ
(πατήρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite),
(a) **a parricide**: [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]] (Av, R, txt.);
(b) **a smiter of his father **: ib. (R, mg.).†
(AS)

G3943.def:
**πάρ-οινος**, -ον
= cl., παροινικός (παρά, οἶνος),
**given to wine, drunken**: [[1Ti.3.3|1Ti.3:3]], [[Tit.1.7|Tit.1:7]].†
(AS)

G3901.def:
**παρα-ρρέω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.44.4|Isa.44:4]] (יָבַל), [[Pro.3.21|Pro.3:21]] * ;]
**to flow by, drift away, slip away**: [[Heb.2.1|Heb.2:1]]†
(AS)

G3927.def:
**παρ-επί-δημος**, -ον
(see: ἐπιδημέω), [in LXX: [[Gen.23.4|Gen.23:4]], [[Psa.39.12|Psa.39:12]] (תּוֹשָׁב)* ;]
**sojourning in a strange place**; as subst., ὁ π., **a sojourner**: of Christians, [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]] ξένοι καὶ π., [[Heb.11.13|Heb.11:13]] πάροικοι καὶ π., [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]] (see Deiss., BS, 149).†
(AS)

G3984.def:
**πεῖρα**, -ας, ἡ
(πειράω), [in LXX: [[Deu.28.56|Deu.28:56]] (π. λαμβάνειν, נָסָה pi.) [[Deu.33.8|Deu.33:8]] (מַסָּה), [[Wis.18.20, 25|Wis.18:20, 25]], [[2Ma.8.9|2Ma.8:9]], [[4Ma.8.1|4Ma.8:1]] * ;]
**trial, experiment**; π. λαμβάνειν, **to make trial, have experience of**: [[Heb.11.29, 36|Heb.11:29, 36]] (for exx., see Field, _Notes_, 232 f.).†
(AS)

G3935.def:
**παρ-ίημι **
[in LXX: [[Jer.4.31|Jer.4:31]] (פָּרַשׂ pi.), etc. ;]
1. **to pass by or over, let alone, disregard**: [[Luk.11.42|Luk.11:42]]
2. **to relax, loosen**; pass., **to be relaxed, weakened, exhausted**: παρειμένας χεῖρας, [[Heb.12.12|Heb.12:12]] (LXX ἀνειμ-).†
(AS)

G3970.def:
**πατρο-παρά-δοτος**, -ον
(πατήρ, παραδίδωμι),
**handed down from one's fathers, inherited**: [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]] (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G3923.def:
**παρ-εισ-φέρω **
**to bring in or supply besides**: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), [[2Pe.1.5|2Pe.1:5]]†
(AS)

G3919.def:
**παρ-εισ-άγω **
1. to lead in by one's side, bring forward, introduce.
2. **In late writers, to introduce or bring in secretly**: [[2Pe.2.1|2Pe.2:1]]†
(AS)

G3921.def:
**παρ-εισ-δύω**
(also -δύνω),
**to slip in secretly, steal in**: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), [[Jude.4|Ju 4]] (cf. also MM, xix).†
(AS)

G3963.def:
**Πάτμος**, -ου, ἡ
**Patmos, an island in the Ægean Sea**: [[Rev.1.9|Rev.1:9]]†
(AS)

G3991.def:
**πέμπτος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי and cognate forms ;]
**fifth**: [[Rev.6.9; 9.1; 16.10; 21.20|Rev.6:9 9:1 16:10 21:20]].†
(AS)

G3917.def:
**πάρδαλις**, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX for נָמֵר, [[Sng.4.8|Sng.4:8]], [[Hos.13.7|Hos.13:7]], [[Isa.11.6|Isa.11:6]], al. ;]
**a panther, leopard**: [[Rev.13.2|Rev.13:2]]†
(AS)

G3990.def:
**πελεκίζω**
(πέλεκυς, a battle-axe),
to out off with an axe, esp. to behead: with accusative, [[Rev.20.4|Rev.20:4]] (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)
